cards.name: Wipe Master Control
cards.summary: Master slider of AE's wipe transition presets Barn Doors, Clam Shell and Paint On (Transitions - Wipes): one 'Transition Completion' value drives the preset's two Linear Wipes (+ Invert) or its Scribble reveal through expressions. On its own it shows nothing.
use_for: one-slider barn-door or clam-shell reveal of a press photo or headline card
'Paint On' scribble reveal of a map, signature or handwritten title in an explainer
graphic wipe between two news cards in a reel
avoid: adding it by match name and expecting a wipe: it is only a slider
Paint On scribble looks dated/cheap on serious documentary footage

params.name: Transition Completion
params.does: progress of the whole wipe 0-100 %; preset expressions map it onto the driven effects (Barn Doors and Clam Shell: both Linear Wipes = linear(TC, 0, 100, 0, 51); Paint On: Scribble End = linear(TC, 0, 67, 0, 100), Stroke Width eases 25 -> 50)
params.typical: keyframe 0 -> 100 over 0.5-1 s (retime the 2 keys the preset ships with)

cards.equivalent: Premiere: Barn Doors transition (Video Transitions > Wipe); Linear Wipe transition or Linear Wipe (Legacy) effect for a one-clip wipe. No paint-on equivalent in PR 2026
cards.scripting: Pseudo effect (expression-control slider defined in Support Files/PresetEffects.xml), not a renderer: addProperty('ADBE CM TransWipe') only adds the slider and changes NO pixels. To get the look, open the comp, select ONLY the target layer, then layer.applyPreset(new File('C:/Program Files/Adobe/Adobe After Effects 2026/Support Files/Presets/Transitions - Wipes/Barn Doors.ffx')) (or Clam Shell.ffx, Paint On.ffx); the preset adds this control plus the effects its expressions drive. The preset ALREADY carries two linear keyframes on Transition Completion (0 -> 100) that land starting at the comp's current time, so set comp.time first and then retime those keys (keyTime/removeKey + setValueAtTime) instead of adding a second pair. Verified from the .ffx files: Barn Doors and Clam Shell = Linear Wipe 1 + Linear Wipe 2 (completion = linear(TC, 0, 100, 0, 51)) + Invert; Paint On = full-layer mask + Scribble (End = linear(TC, 0, 67, 0, 100)). Instance names differ: Barn Doors names the control 'Wipe Master Control 1' and its expressions use that name; Clam Shell and Paint On use 'Wipe Master Control'. So find it by match name (layer.property('ADBE Effect Parade').property('ADBE CM TransWipe')) and never rename it. Which end (0 or 100) is fully visible is not verified per preset: render frames at 0 and 100 before relying on direction. Card Wipe presets use the separate 'Card Wipe Master Control'.

cards.name: Wipe Master Controls

cards.name: Wobble Bounce
cards.summary: Expression-control set (Dan Ebberts behaviour family) for a decaying bounce with a secondary wobble, starting after a delay and optionally repeating. It has no expressions attached, so alone it does nothing visible.
use_for: bouncy drop-in of a sticker, icon or logo bug in a social reel
playful pop of a 'FACT CHECK' or emoji badge in an explainer
elastic entrance for a lower-third plate on a light-hearted segment
avoid: serious news, obituary or documentary beats: reads cartoonish
full-frame footage: bounce exposes the frame edges and black background
assuming the control animates anything by itself: it does not

params.name: Amplitude
params.does: size of the bounce in pixels (sign flips direction)

params.name: Frequency
params.does: bounces per second

params.name: Decay
params.does: how fast the bounce dies out (higher = settles sooner)

params.name: Wobble Amplitude
params.does: strength of the secondary wobble riding on the bounce

params.name: Wobble Frequency
params.does: wobbles per second

params.name: Wobble Decay
params.does: how fast the wobble dies out

params.name: Delay
params.does: seconds after the layer in-point before the motion starts

params.name: Cycle Time
params.does: repeat the motion every N seconds (0 = play once)

cards.equivalent: Premiere: none; keyframe Motion Position/Scale with overshoot (Bezier) easing
cards.scripting: Pseudo effect (expression-control sliders defined in Support Files/PresetEffects.xml), not a renderer: addProperty('ADBE DE Wobble Bounce') only adds the sliders and changes NO pixels. No .ffx preset in the AE 2026 (or 2024/2025) Presets folder uses this control (scanned 2026-10-03), so nothing drives it: a script must write its own expression that reads these sliders, or simply keyframe the transform instead. Slider meanings are inferred from names and ranges (unverified). Example on Position: c=effect('Wobble Bounce'); t=time-inPoint-c('Delay'); if(t>=0 && c('Cycle Time')>0) t=t%c('Cycle Time'); t<0 ? value : value+[0,-c('Amplitude')*Math.abs(Math.sin(c('Frequency')*2*Math.PI*t))/Math.exp(c('Decay')*t)]; wobble on Rotation (degrees) or Scale (squash %): value + c('Wobble Amplitude')*Math.sin(c('Wobble Frequency')*2*Math.PI*t)/Math.exp(c('Wobble Decay')*t) with the same t and guard. Ready-made alternatives that DO ship: Presets/Transitions - Movement/Pop and Wobble In.ffx and Presets/Behaviors/Scale Bounce - layer markers.ffx / Scale Bounce - random.ffx.

cards.scripting: Pseudo effect (expression-control sliders defined in Support Files/PresetEffects.xml), not a renderer: addProperty('ADBE CM ZoomSpiral') only adds the sliders and changes NO pixels. To get the look, open the comp, select ONLY the target layer, then layer.applyPreset(new File('C:/Program Files/Adobe/Adobe After Effects 2026/Support Files/Presets/Transitions - Movement/Zoom - spiral.ffx')); the preset adds this control plus the effects its expressions drive. The preset ALREADY carries two linear keyframes on Transition Completion (0 -> 100) that land starting at the comp's current time, so set comp.time first and then retime those keys (keyTime/removeKey + setValueAtTime) instead of adding a second pair. Expressions address the control by its display name ('Zoom - spiral'), so never rename the effect. Verified from the preset: Transform Scale = linear(TC, 0, 100, 0, 100); Transform Position = layer centre + [cos a, sin a] * linear(TC, 0, 100, Spiral Size, 0) with a = linear(TC, 0, 100, Start-90, End-90) degrees, so the radius shrinks to 0 and the layer lands at its own centre. Angles have no harvested limit; keep them within -3600..3600.
